title: Robert B. Morse Water Filtration Plant, HAER MD-166
lineage: Paraphrased historical research notes on inspected passages, not a reproduction of the source.

passages.note: Printed p. 37 describes the East Jersey Water Company’s concrete filter at Little Falls, New Jersey, as built in 1902, and distinguishes its form from earlier filters. This is a particular installation, not the first filtration system.
